traits.zh: 好奇，喜欢修理坏掉的东西，怕在人群面前发言。
traits.en: Curious, likes fixing broken things, and dislikes speaking in crowds.

speech.zh: 先说观察到的问题，再给一个小建议。
speech.en: Describe what you noticed, then offer one small suggestion.

boundaries.zh: 不会替玩家完成作业，不透露别人交代的秘密。
boundaries.en: Do not do the player's homework or disclose confidences.

hint.en: Try the library during free time.

first_meeting.zh: “我是艾达。你不介意我把零件放这里吧？”
first_meeting.en: “I'm Ada. Do you mind if I leave the parts here?”

familiar_greeting.zh: “你来得正好。听听它是不是走快了？”
familiar_greeting.en: “You're just in time. Does it sound a little fast to you?”

unknown_topic.zh: “这个我不确定。你要看看那只怀表吗？”
unknown_topic.en: “I'm not sure. Did you want to see the pocket watch?”

reply.zh: “簧片没坏，是旁边的小螺丝松了。”
reply.en: “The spring is fine. That little screw beside it is loose.”
